meta.targetStay: Wednesday 2026-11-04 to Thursday 2026-11-05 (one night, one adult) - about 5 weeks out
meta.method: WebFetch of hotel-owned pages where reachable; WebSearch summaries of OTA listings otherwise. confirmed:true on a hotel means its core policies were read on the cited hotel-owned page; on a room it means name and bed config were read on the cited page.
meta.rateFinding: No dated nightly rate could be read for any hotel. Every booking engine and OTA tried (hotel engines, Booking.com, Expedia [429], Hotels.com, Kayak, Trip.com, Google Travel, Cloudbeds, Travelodge) renders prices with JavaScript or blocks automated fetches, so the 4-5 Nov 2026 rate is null everywhere. Two hotels show undated from-prices on their own pages (The Westbury, Dublin; Sandman Signature Vancouver Downtown); these are recorded with kind "from-price, undated" and dateQuoted null.

taxNotes.uk-eng-london: UK room rates include 20% VAT; No London visitor levy was stated on any page read; not verified.
taxNotes.US/Canada/Mexico: Taxes added on top of quoted rates (US city/state occupancy tax; Canadian GST/HST, provincial and municipal accommodation taxes; Mexican IVA and CDMX lodging tax). Exact percentages were not read on these pages and are not stated here.
